summary: Physics collision-shape initializer. Writes a discriminator word at this+8, the subtype constant 4 at this+28, and the external data pointer a3 at this+32, then seeds a six-dword stack vector with raw 0.0/2.0-ish float bit patterns and passes it to CollisionInvMassStore with the literal 10.0, followed by F_6FieldBulkSetter with six float bit-pattern literals. When a4 is non-zero, hands off to ShortComputation_e770(this, a4, 0); otherwise returns a4. Invoked by sub_40FE50.

local_names.a3: external data pointer stored at this+32 and consumed by the collision-store helpers
local_names.a4: continuation trigger; non-zero selects ShortComputation_e770 and is also the default return value
local_names.v6: six-dword stack vector of raw float bit patterns (0, 1072693248, 0, 1071644672, 0, 1073217536)

operations.description: Write the 16-bit discriminator a2 to this+8
Write the constant 4 to this+28 (physics shape subtype marker)
Write the external data pointer a3 to this+32
Initialize the v6 stack vector with six dword literals (0, 1072693248, 0, 1071644672, 0, 1073217536), kept in their raw bit-pattern spelling
CollisionInvMassStore(10.0, v6) stores the literal inverse-mass 10.0 alongside the six-dword v6 vector into collision data
F_6FieldBulkSetter(0, 1085022208, 0, 1078853632, 0x40000000, 1071854387) bulk-writes six float fields into the collision data structure
When a4 is non-zero, the function returns ShortComputation_e770(this, a4, 0) instead of falling through
Return a4 unchanged when a4 is zero; otherwise return the ShortComputation_e770 result. Called by sub_40FE50 (0040fe50)
